project.name: gateway-service
project.description: The single origin the browser (and the frontend's Vite dev proxy) talks to. Reactive (WebFlux/Netty), deliberately — a blocking gateway would buffer the two SSE streams (/api/chat/stream, /code/*/stream) instead of forwarding them chunk by chunk. Phase 0: pure transparent passthrough to legacy-monolith, no auth logic of its own. From Phase 1 onward it takes over Firebase verification + session-cookie handling for each domain's routes as that domain is extracted — see this module's routing config and the migration plan's Reliability Strategy section for how a route's cutover is a config change, not a code change.
